summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Growth ETF (TGRT) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on large cap equity. TGRT is an actively managed fund that invests in US large-cap companies believed to have strong growth potential TGRT was launched on Jun 14, 2023 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.

holdings.infoBox: TGRT is an equity ETF with a total of 94 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 16.33%, Alphabet at 10.26%, Apple at 6.82%, Microsoft at 5.19%, and Broadcom at 4.84%.
